prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art game animation atlas, neutral NPC speech-mouth poses
Input image: Image 1 is the only reference, mouth-reference-grid.png. It shows a 3×3 grid of repeated native lower 64×29 portrait halves, enlarged 8× with nearest-neighbor pixels. Treat it as exact character, crop, palette, and pixel-texture reference.
Primary request: Create one complete 3×3 atlas of this exact lower-face half. Keep nine cells as identical whole lower 64×29 crops, with clear even boundaries and original composition. Row-major cells A B C / D E F / G H X. Each cell keeps same identity, jaw, nose base, cheeks, chin, neck, hair and background framing. Change only the small mouth pose and minimal lip-corner tension required. Preserve original lip scale and soft brown lips. Neutral relaxed delivery; avoid exaggerated emotion.
Required Rhubarb pose meanings, follow each explicitly:
A: closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M.
B: narrow horizontal opening, teeth nearly together, for consonants and EE.
C: medium relaxed unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide vertical AA opening, visibly larger than C.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small forward pucker for UW/OW/W; not a tooth bite.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V; not a wide vowel or pucker.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for long L; opening between C and D; a tiny tongue may be hard to see at native scale.
X: relaxed closed idle lips.
Color and texture: preserve muted warm tan/brown skin, soft low-contrast brown lips and original pixel clusters. Use restrained warm teeth and dark cavities only where pose requires; no bright white blocks. No lipstick red, orange skin, heavy outlines, harsh contrast, blur, smooth vectors, antialiasing, text, labels, borders, or watermarks.
Composition constraint: output only the 3×3 grid of complete lower halves with the same aspect ratio and cell proportions as reference. Do not create full portraits, tight mouth crops, alternate framing, extra panels, or background redesign.
